description: 虚构的双语课堂与团队资料；调参前冻结，标准答案为来源定位而非模型生成文本。

documents.text: 青禾课堂的项目资料统一保存为 .blocky 文件。
蓝星小组每周三下午在三号教室讨论机器人作品。
向日葵实验的记录表需要填写日期、光照时长和植株高度。
北斗图书角归还图书时，把书放入绿色的归还箱。
松果课程的讨论规则是先听完同伴发言，再表达自己的意见。
银河创作节报名截止日期是虚构学期的十月十五日。
海风气象站用雨量筒收集降水，用温度计测量气温。
银杏观察队将落叶按形状分类，再比较不同叶片的边缘。
萤火计划要求每次修改作品后写下修改原因，并保留上一个版本。
白鹭研究组给每份引用标注资料名称和原文行号，方便同伴核对。
Cedar team's release checklist requires a clean build and a saved rollback copy.
The fictional Orbit library stores its catalog in a file named catalog.json.
Meadow group's sensor logs use UTC timestamps and millimeters for rainfall.
The fictional Comet workshop opens its red toolbox only after the teacher checks the materials.
Willow's document sync compares content hashes and skips files that have not changed.
Pebble team's project folder separates source code, tests, and generated output into different directories.
At the fictional Aurora exhibition, each project poster names the question, method, observations, and conclusion.
The Maple reading group records the book title and page number beside every quotation.
Harbor's task queue stops accepting new work when cancellation is requested, then closes its active worker.
Cloudberry's editor keeps window size in local session settings instead of the project document.
仅限管理员的虚构红杉活动地点是七号房间。
仅限管理员的虚构海棠活动标记是紫色三角。
仅限管理员的虚构山茶资料柜位于北侧。
仅限管理员的虚构星尘课程在星期二召开。
仅限管理员的虚构雪松小组使用橙色文件夹。
Restricted fictional Finch notes name cabinet F as the storage location.
Restricted fictional Acorn notes assign project marker amber circle.
Restricted fictional Juniper notes schedule a meeting on Thursday.
Restricted fictional Kite notes place spare paper on shelf nine.
Restricted fictional Birch notes select the silver notebook.
